sellingPoints: Industry-leading low total cost of ownership
High monthly duty cycle for workgroup device
competitiveAdvantages: Ceramic drum lasts up to 300,000 pages
Separate toner and drum = lower cost per page
Extremely low energy consumption in sleep mode
idealFor: Cost-conscious businesses with technical IT staff
Businesses wanting to minimize supply interruptions

unboxing: Remove all packing materials and protective foam
Remove orange protective shipping lock from scanner
initialSetup: Run test print to verify operation

ethernet: Connect Ethernet cable to RJ-45 port on back
Navigate to System Menu > Network > TCP/IP
Select Auto Obtain (DHCP) or configure Static IP
Print network status page to verify connection
Access Command Center RX at http://[printer-ip]
wifi: Navigate to System Menu > Network > Wireless LAN
Enter Wi-Fi password using on-screen keyboard
Confirm connection and print network status page
Alternatively, use WPS push-button method if supported by router

driverInstallation.windows: Download KX Driver from Kyocera website. Run installer and follow prompts. Select network search to automatically detect printer.
driverInstallation.mac: Download macOS driver from Kyocera website. Open .dmg file and run installer. Add printer via System Preferences using Bonjour or IP address.
driverInstallation.linux: Use Kyocera Linux PPD files available from support website. Add printer via CUPS web interface at localhost:631.

configPages.meterPage: Press Menu > Report > Page Counter to print current page counts for device and toner
configPages.configPage: Press Menu > Report > Status Page to print complete device configuration
configPages.networkConfigPage: Press Menu > Report > Network Status to print detailed network configuration
configPages.webInterface: Enter printer IP address in browser (e.g., http://192.168.1.100) to access Command Center RX. Default admin password is 'admin'.

commonIssues: After initial setup, configure Scan to Email in Command Center RX > Email Settings
For Scan to SMB, configure Windows domain credentials in Address Book
Update firmware via Command Center RX for latest features and bug fixes
Install Kyocera Print Center app for mobile printing support

solutions: Power off printer for 30 seconds
Open front cover and clean LSU mirror with dry lint-free cloth
Check for obstructions in paper path
If error persists after power cycle, contact Kyocera service
This error may require technician intervention
Open all covers indicated on control panel display
Remove jammed paper carefully in direction of arrow
Check paper is loaded correctly with guides snug
Clean feed rollers with damp cloth
Use paper within 60-220 g/m² specification

causes: Toner kit at end of rated yield (7,200 pages)
solutions: Order replacement TK-1172 toner kit
Open front cover
Remove old toner container
Shake new toner container 15-20 times before installing
Insert new toner and close cover
Note: Drum unit does NOT need replacement - it lasts 300k pages

causes: Device has reached 200,000 page maintenance interval
solutions: Order MK-1152 maintenance kit
Kit includes fuser unit and feed rollers
Replacement can be done by IT staff or certified technician
Follow maintenance kit installation guide
Reset counter via Service Menu after installation

accessInstructions: Look for jammed paper at rear of cassette cavity
clearanceSteps: Remove any jammed sheets from feed area
Check feed rollers for damage or debris
Reload paper ensuring stack is below max line
Adjust paper guides to match paper size exactly
prevention: Fan paper before loading to prevent static
Do not mix different paper types in same cassette
Keep paper stored in humidity-controlled environment (45-55% RH)

accessInstructions: CAUTION: Fuser may be extremely hot - wait if needed
clearanceSteps: If fuser is hot, wait 20 minutes before proceeding
Gently pull jammed paper straight out
Do not touch fuser roller directly
Close rear cover firmly until it clicks
prevention: Use correct paper weight settings in driver
Avoid printing on damp or curled paper
Clean paper path during maintenance intervals
Replace fuser at recommended interval (200k pages)

accessInstructions: Press green tabs on duplex unit
clearanceSteps: Remove jammed paper from duplex path
Check for torn pieces and remove completely
Push duplex unit back in until it locks
prevention: Use 60-105 g/m² paper for duplex printing
Avoid specialty paper (glossy, textured) for duplex
Ensure duplex setting matches paper type in driver

solutions: Check toner level via control panel Menu > Report > Toner Status
Disable EcoPrint mode in driver settings
Adjust print density: Menu > System Menu > Common Settings > Density
Shake toner container gently to redistribute
Replace toner if below 10%
Print several test pages to clear minor streaks
Clean drum surface: Menu > Maintenance > Drum Refresh
Inspect drum unit (DK-1150) for visible damage
Check toner container for leaks
If drum is damaged, replacement is needed (rated for 300k pages)
Ensure environmental specs met (10-32°C, 10-80% RH)
Verify correct paper type selected in driver and control panel
Use higher quality paper (80 g/m² recommended)
Disable EcoPrint and adjust density to higher setting
Run drum refresh cycle
Check drum page count - replacement may be needed if >290k pages

diagnosticSteps: Print network status page from control panel
Verify IP address is valid and on correct subnet
Verify printer shows 'Ready' status on control panel
solutions: Ensure network cable is securely connected
Try different network cable or port on switch
Manually assign static IP if DHCP is failing
Reset network settings: Menu > System Menu > Network > Reset Network
Update network firmware via Command Center RX
Disable firewall temporarily to test connectivity

diagnosticSteps: Access Command Center RX via browser
Verify SMTP server address and port
Test SMTP server from another device
solutions: Configure SMTP server: Command Center RX > Email > SMTP Settings
Common settings: Gmail (smtp.gmail.com:587), O365 (smtp.office365.com:587)
Enable SMTP Authentication and enter credentials
For Gmail, use App Password (not regular password)
Select TLS or STARTTLS encryption method
Add device email address in From Address field
Test by sending to internal email first

diagnosticSteps: Test folder access from Windows PC with same credentials
solutions: In Command Center RX, configure Address Book entry
Use format: \\192.168.1.10\scans (IP preferred over hostname)
Enter domain\username and password with write access
Enable SMBv1 on Windows if required (for older Kyocera firmware)
Or update Kyocera firmware to support SMB2/SMB3
Ensure folder has write permissions for specified user
Disable password-protected sharing on Windows for testing

procedure: Open front cover
Remove old toner container by pulling straight out
Remove new TK-1172 from packaging
Shake container 15-20 times horizontally
Remove protective seal
Insert container until it clicks
Close front cover
Order DK-1150 drum unit well in advance
Open front cover and remove toner container
Pull blue drum release lever
Pull drum unit straight out
Unpack new drum unit and remove all protective materials
Insert new drum until it locks
Reinstall toner container
Close cover and print test page

generalMaintenance.frequency: Every 200,000 pages or when 'Ready for Maintenance' appears
procedure: Order MK-1152 maintenance kit
Power off and unplug printer
Wait 30 minutes for fuser to cool
Follow kit instructions to replace fuser unit
Replace feed rollers included in kit
Power on and access Service Menu (press 1203 on control panel)
Reset maintenance counter
Run test prints to verify operation

generalMaintenance.frequency: Weekly in busy environments, monthly otherwise
procedure: Lift scanner cover
Spray glass cleaner on lint-free cloth (not directly on glass)
Wipe scanner glass and document glass
Clean ADF feed rollers with damp cloth
Allow to dry completely
Test scan quality

generalMaintenance.frequency: Every 6 months or when issues occur
procedure: Check current firmware: Menu > Report > Status Page
Visit Kyocera support website and search for M2640idw
Download latest firmware file
Access Command Center RX via browser
Login as admin (default password: admin)
Navigate to Firmware Update
Upload firmware file and click Update
Do not power off during update (takes 5-10 minutes)
Printer will reboot automatically when complete

firmware.updateProcedure: Access Command Center RX > Firmware Update. Upload firmware file downloaded from Kyocera support site.

extendedOptions: Kyocera 3-year total warranty with next-day response
